data.name: Bug Bounce
data.detailed_description:
Bug Bounce is a co-op action roguelike where momentum becomes a weapon.

Play as evolving insect heroes and fight through dangerous swarms, deadly biomes, and massive bosses in a stylized underground world. Blast enemies apart, launch them into each other, and build absurdly powerful upgrade combinations as your run escalates into physics-driven chaos.

In Bug Bounce, movement and impact matter. Knockback is not just crowd control. It is damage, positioning, combo potential, and survival. Every hit can send enemies flying, trigger collisions, and create destructive chain reactions across the battlefield.

Whether you are fighting solo or alongside friends, every run is about building something powerful, weird, and eventually game-breaking.

What Makes Bug Bounce Different?

Momentum-Based Combat

Turn force into damage. Knock enemies into walls, hazards, other enemies, and the environment itself. Build around bounce, launch, collision, and control to create chaotic combat scenarios that keep escalating.

Deep Build Variety

Shape each run with upgrades that alter your attacks, abilities, and playstyle. Stack mutations, weapon modifiers, and major transformations to create synergistic builds that can spiral into total mayhem.

Mid-Run Evolution

Your character grows during the run, unlocking stronger forms and new possibilities as you evolve into something deadlier.

Solo or Online Co-Op

Take on the swarm alone or with friends. Coordinate roles, combine effects, and create even bigger combos in co-op.

A World of Bugs and Bosses

Descend into a stylized insect world filled with enemy families, elite variants, and dangerous bosses that demand movement, awareness, and build adaptation.

Features

  • Online co-op roguelike action

  • Momentum and knockback-based combat

  • Build-defining mutations and weapon modifiers

  • Mid-run metamorphosis and evolution

  • Swarms, elites, flying enemies, and bosses

  • Replayable runs with strong synergy potential

  • Stylized insect fantasy with high-chaos combat

Hatch. Evolve. Ascend.
